paragraphs: R' Pinhas bar Hama. Bava Batra 116a: several expositions. Shemot Rabbah 9:1; Shoher Tov, Midrash Tehillim 19:2–3; and Yalkut Shimoni on Psalms, remez 673: R' Pinhas the priest, bar Hama. A physician wished to teach him the Explicit Name, but he declined because he had accepted a tithe [in Kohelet Rabbah, the physician withholds the teaching after hearing this]: Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 3:7:8, and Kohelet Rabbah 3:11:3. In R' Aivu's name: Bereshit Rabbah 42:2. In R' Hilkiyah the Southerner's name: Yelammedenu, Kedoshim [Tanchuma Buber, Kedoshim 1:1]. In R' Hilkiyah's name, in R' Simon's name, in R' Reuven's name: a separate passage in Tanchuma, Mishpatim 15:1. Perhaps his father Hama was Hama bar Abba, Shmuel's brother, and the Pinhas mentioned just before this was his uncle. Perhaps R' Hanina bar Hama the priest was his brother.
